errors.what: Initial attempt to inspect HTML via 'clan read html' failed (no such subcommand); also grep on the zipped .clan binary found nothing
errors.recovered_by: Used 'clan read human' to print the rendered HTML and locate the #risk-rows selector and existing row markup

problems_and_friction: patch-data merge-patch replaces arrays, so I had to read the existing risks, re-author all 3 prior entries plus the new one, and resend the full array — that re-authoring is the bulk of the output bytes. Discovering the HTML selector required 'clan read human' since there is no read-html subcommand.
context_understood: Add a fourth Vendor lock-in risk by replacing the full risks array via patch-data and appending one literal <tr> to #risk-rows via patch-html, keeping bound data and the literal HTML table in sync without pack-html.
